name: com.draftcompare/legal-diff
title: DraftCompare Legal Diff
description: Deterministic legal contract redlines, risk flags, and figure/date audits. Free & stateless.

tools.name: compare_drafts
tools.description: Produces an exact, deterministic word-level redline between an original text and a revised text (up to 8,000 chars each). Groups contiguous deletions and insertions into structured updates with surrounding context, risk tags, and a unified Markdown redline.

original_text.description: Original contract or clause text (max 8,000 characters).

revised_text.description: Revised contract or clause text (max 8,000 characters).

ignore_case.description: Ignore letter casing and diacritic differences when diffing (default: false).

max_changes.description: Maximum number of structured change items to return (default: 50).

tools.name: audit_legal_risks
tools.description: Runs DraftCompare deterministic legal risk rules over all changes between original and revised texts (up to 8,000 chars each). Flags HIGH and MEDIUM risk modifications affecting money, percentages, liability, indemnification, termination, liquidated damages, jurisdiction, confidentiality, exclusivity, or obligation/negation flips (shall/must/may/not/without prior) in English and Spanish.

original_text.description: Original contract or clause text (max 8,000 characters).

revised_text.description: Revised contract or clause text (max 8,000 characters).

min_severity.description: Minimum risk severity to include: "high", "med" (default), or "low".

tools.name: audit_critical_figures
tools.description: Deterministically extracts and compares critical contractual figures between original and revised texts (up to 8,000 chars each): monetary amounts ($, €, £, ¥, USD/EUR/GBP), percentages (%), dates (canonicalized across ISO, DD/MM/YYYY, English, and Spanish formats to prevent false positives), and deadlines/terms (days, business days, months, years).

original_text.description: Original contract or clause text (max 8,000 characters).

revised_text.description: Revised contract or clause text (max 8,000 characters).

tools.name: get_comparison_stats
tools.description: Computes fast executive triage statistics comparing original and revised texts (up to 8,000 chars each): word and character counts, net delta, similarity percentage, added/removed/updated counts, critical figure change count, and HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW risk counts.

original_text.description: Original contract or clause text (max 8,000 characters).

revised_text.description: Revised contract or clause text (max 8,000 characters).
